courses.title: የሞባይል ጥገና ስልጠና (Mobile Maintenance Training)
courses.description: ተግባራዊ የስማርት ፎን እና ታብሌት ጥገና ስልጠና። ስክሪን፣ ባትሪ፣ ቻርጂንግ ፖርት፣ ማዘርቦርድ ማይክሮ-ሶልደሪንግ እና ሶፍትዌር ጥገና። Learn to diagnose and repair smartphones, tablets, and mobile devices at the micro-component level.

syllabus.title: Module 1: Safety, Precision Tools & Hardware Teardown
syllabus.description: ESD ground isolation, precision screwdrivers, heating plates, and safe battery extraction.
lessons: Workstation safety & ground loop prevention
Heating plate & hot air adhesive softening
Display, frame, and battery extraction
Micro-bracket and screw organization
syllabus.labMilestone: Perform clean teardown and reassembly of iPhone and Android test units.

syllabus.title: Module 2: Multimeter Diagnostics & Primary Power Rails
syllabus.description: Diode mode drop testing on FPC connectors, schematic reading, and DC power supply current draw analysis.
lessons: Diode mode readings vs reference values
VBUS, VBAT & VDD_MAIN power sequencing
DC bench power supply short vs open signatures
Freeze spray and thermal short isolation
syllabus.labMilestone: Locate shorted capacitor on main power rail and safely restore boot.

syllabus.title: Module 3: Micro-Soldering & Jumper Running
syllabus.description: Stereomicroscope soldering, 0.02mm insulated jumper wire routing, and charge port replacement.
lessons: Microscope focus and ergonomics
0.02mm jumper wire routing for torn pads
UV-curable solder mask application
Type-C and micro-USB port rework
syllabus.labMilestone: Reconstruct torn motherboard pads using jumper wire under magnification.

syllabus.title: Module 4: BGA IC Reballing & Software Recovery
syllabus.description: Underfill glue removal, BGA stencil reballing, PMIC replacement, and firmware flashing.
lessons: Underfill resin softening and scraping
Direct-heat stencils and solder paste reballing
Power Management IC (PMIC) replacement
Firmware flashing and bootloop recovery
syllabus.labMilestone: Reball and solder back a PMIC chip with verified device boot.

courses.audience: Students, technicians, and entrepreneurs launching phone repair shops

courses.title: የቴሌቪዥንና ሌሎችም ጥገና ስልጠና (TV and Other Maintenance Training)
courses.description: የኤልኢዲ፣ ኤልሲዲ እና ስማርት ቴሌቪዥኖች፣ ፓወር ቦርድ (SMPS)፣ ባክላይት ድራይቨር፣ ቲ-ኮን ቦርድ እና የቤት ውስጥ ኤሌክትሮኒክስ ጥገና። Comprehensive troubleshooting for LED, LCD, smart TVs, SMPS boards, and home electronics.
skills: Tape cutoff method for panel COF shorts

syllabus.title: Module 1: SMPS Power Supply Boards & High Voltage Inverters
syllabus.description: Standby voltages (3.3V/5V), Power-ON simulation, and switching rails.
lessons: Power board safety & capacitor discharging
PS_ON bench simulation using 1K resistors
Active PFC boost converter diagnostics
Inverter and protection shutdown circuits
syllabus.labMilestone: Force-power an isolated TV power board with dummy load resistors.

syllabus.title: Module 2: LED Backlight Arrays & Driver Circuits
syllabus.description: LED strip testing, safe LCD glass removal, and current limiter modification.
lessons: Dedicated backlight tester usage
Safe LCD glass panel suction removal
SMD LED diode replacement
Current sense resistor mod for longer lifespan
syllabus.labMilestone: Disassemble 43" panel, replace burnt LEDs, and perform current mod.

syllabus.title: Module 3: Main Motherboards & T-Con Timing
syllabus.description: Video processors, LVDS differential pairs, and T-Con voltage rails.
lessons: Main board firmware and SPI flash recovery
LVDS clock and data differential lines
T-Con rails: VGH, VGL, AVDD, VCOM
Tape cutoff method for shorted panel glass
syllabus.labMilestone: Isolate shorted panel ribbon using tape cutoff method to restore picture.

courses.audience: Electronics enthusiasts and TV repair technicians

courses.title: የኮምፒውተርና የላፕቶፕ ጥገና ስልጠና (Computer and Laptop Maintenance Training)
courses.description: የዴስክቶፕ እና የላፕቶፕ ሀርድዌር ምርመራ፣ የማዘርቦርድ ፓወር ሬይል፣ ራም እና ኤስኤስዲ ማሻሻያ፣ እና የዊንዶውስ/ሊኑክስ ጥገና። Master laptop hardware diagnostics, motherboard power rails, thermal management, and system upgrades.

syllabus.title: Module 1: Desktop & Laptop Architecture & Teardown
syllabus.description: Component identification, form factors, thermal paths, and safe disassemblies.
lessons: CPU socket types and chipset topologies
Precision teardown of Ultrabooks and gaming laptops
Thermal cooling maintenance and fan bearing service
Display hinges, bezel, and keyboard replacements
syllabus.labMilestone: Perform complete disassembly and thermal overhaul of modern laptops.

syllabus.title: Module 2: Power Sequencing & Motherboard Diagnostics
syllabus.description: S5, S3, and S0 power states, charging ICs, and buck converter troubleshooting.
lessons: 19V DC-in rail and current sensing resistors
3.3V and 5V standby PWM buck regulators
Embedded Controller (EC / KBC) signal lines
Power sequence timing from button press to POST
syllabus.labMilestone: Diagnose non-powering laptop motherboard and replace shorted mosfet.

syllabus.title: Module 3: BIOS Programming & OS Recovery
syllabus.description: SPI flash programmer (CH341A), ME region cleaning, and fast operating system deployment.
lessons: EEPROM flash chip extraction and clip programming
Intel Management Engine (ME) clean dump injection
Bootable diagnostic USB tools and drive cloning
Data recovery from damaged file systems
syllabus.labMilestone: Flash corrupt BIOS chip on board and restore complete POST boot.

courses.audience: Aspiring IT technicians, PC builders, and computer support specialists

courses.title: የፍሪጅ ጥገና ስልጠና (Refrigerator Maintenance Training)
courses.description: የቤት ውስጥ እና የንግድ ፍሪጆች ኮምፕረሰር ጥገና፣ ጋዝ ሙሌት (R134a/R600a)፣ ቴርሞስታት፣ የካፒላሪ ቱቦ እና የኤሌክትሪክ ሰርኪውት ስልጠና። Practical training on compressors, refrigerants, gas leak detection, brazing, and cooling circuit calibration.

syllabus.title: Module 1: Refrigeration Cycle & Mechanical Components
syllabus.description: Vapor-compression cycle, evaporator, condenser, capillary tube, and compressor operation.
lessons: Thermodynamics of cooling and heat transfer
Hermetic compressor internal mechanics
Condenser heat dissipation and filter driers
Capillary tube sizing and expansion
syllabus.labMilestone: Test compressor windings for resistance and ground shorts using multimeter.

syllabus.title: Module 2: Copper Brazing, Flaring & Vacuuming
syllabus.description: Oxygen-acetylene / propane torch brazing, tube bending, flare fittings, and deep vacuuming.
lessons: Safe torch operation and brazing rod alloys
Copper-to-copper and copper-to-steel joints
Two-stage vacuum pump operation and micron measurement
Nitrogen pressure testing for micro-leaks
syllabus.labMilestone: Braze service valve, pull deep vacuum, and prove zero pressure loss.

syllabus.title: Module 3: Gas Charging & Electrical Controls
syllabus.description: Weighing R134a / R600a charges, defrost thermostats, bi-metal sensors, and inverter cooling boards.
lessons: Refrigerant charging by digital scale weight
PTC starting relay, overload protector, and run capacitor
Defrost timer, heating element, and drain trough service
Inverter compressor DC driver boards and error codes
syllabus.labMilestone: Complete full vacuum and gas recharge cycle to restore sub-zero cooling.

courses.audience: Technicians and trainees seeking high-demand appliance maintenance skills

courses.title: የህንፃዎች/የኤሌክትሪክ መስመር ዝርጋታ (Buildings / Electrical Line Installation)
courses.description: የመኖሪያ እና የንግድ ህንፃዎች የኤሌክትሪክ መስመር ዝርጋታ፣ የፓናል ቦርድ ገጠማ፣ የሰርኪውት ብሬከር ስሌት እና የደህንነት መርሆዎች። Residential and commercial electrical conduit layout, distribution panel installation, circuit breaker sizing, and grounding.
skills: MCB, MCCB, and RCD earth leakage breakers
Lighting, two-way switching, and power sockets

syllabus.title: Module 1: Electrical Safety, Tools & Schematics
syllabus.description: Ethiopian building electrical codes, schematic drawing, and wire gauge calculation.
lessons: High voltage safety and lockout/tagout procedures
Electrical blueprint and conduit routing symbols
Wire gauge (AWG / mm²) calculation based on ampacity
Conduit types (PVC, EMT) and bending tools
syllabus.labMilestone: Draft schematic and bend PVC conduits with clean 90° bends on simulation wall.

syllabus.title: Module 2: Distribution Board Wiring & Protection
syllabus.description: Main switch, RCD / ELCB shock prevention, busbars, and individual circuit breakers.
lessons: Sub-panel vs main distribution board layouts
Sizing MCB breakers for lighting vs motor loads
Residual Current Devices (RCD) sensitivity and testing
Earth-neutral separation and busbar balancing
syllabus.labMilestone: Wire complete 8-way distribution board with operational RCD trip testing.

syllabus.title: Module 3: Residential & Commercial Circuit Installation
syllabus.description: Intermediate switches, motion sensors, automatic water pump controllers, and generator changeovers.
lessons: Two-way and intermediate staircase lighting circuits
High-power appliance circuits (water heaters, stoves)
Manual and automatic transfer switch (ATS) wiring
Megger insulation resistance testing
syllabus.labMilestone: Wire full apartment mock-up with lighting, power circuits, and changeover switch.

courses.audience: Electricians, construction contractors, and technicians preparing for COC certification
courses.duration: 3 Months (Aligned with COC Basic Electrical Standards)

courses.title: የኔትወርክ ዝርጋታ (Network Installation)
courses.description: የላን (LAN) እና ዋይፋይ ኔትወርክ መስመር ዝርጋታ፣ የኢተርኔት ኬብል ክሪምፒንግ፣ ራውተር/ስዊች ማስተካከል እና የኔትወርክ ደህንነት። Structured Ethernet cabling, fiber patch cords, Wi-Fi access point deployment, patch panel punching, and router configuration.
skills: Cat6 RJ45 crimping & punch-down patch panels
IP addressing, DHCP, and DNS configuration

syllabus.title: Module 1: Structured Cabling & Physical Infrastructure
syllabus.description: T568A/T568B wiring standards, keystones, server racks, and cable management.
lessons: Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6a, and fiber optic cable types
Precision RJ45 crimping and continuity testing
110-type punch down on 24-port patch panels
Cable management channels and server rack layout
syllabus.labMilestone: Terminate patch panel and wall keystone jacks with 100% pass on cable tester.

syllabus.title: Module 2: Network Equipment Configuration & Wi-Fi
syllabus.description: Managed switches, Wi-Fi heatmaps, VLANs, and broadband router setup.
lessons: Managed switch port configuration and VLAN tagging
Commercial Access Points (MikroTik / UniFi) deployment
Wi-Fi channel planning and 2.4GHz / 5GHz interference reduction
DHCP reservation, static IPs, and port forwarding
syllabus.labMilestone: Deploy office network connecting 10 client devices with roaming Wi-Fi.

courses.audience: IT administrators, network installers, and office technicians

courses.title: የዲሽ ተከላና ጥገና (Dish Installation and Maintenance)
courses.description: የሳተላይት ዲሽ ተከላ እና አቅጣጫ ማስተካከል፣ ባለብዙ ኤልኤንቢ (LNB) ገጠማ፣ የሪሲቨር ሶፍትዌር መጫን እና የሲግናል ማስተካከል ስልጠና። Satellite dish alignment (NSS 12, Eutelsat, Amos), multi-LNB brackets, DiSEqC switches, and digital receiver programming.
skills: Azimuth, elevation, and LNB skew alignment
DiSEqC switch setup & RF coaxial cabling
Satellite receiver software flashing & channel scanning

syllabus.title: Module 1: Satellite Orbit Fundamentals & Dish Mounting
syllabus.description: Geostationary orbits, compass coordinates, rigid wall mounting, and dish assembly.
lessons: Orbital degrees and satellite footprint coverage in Ethiopia
Plumb-line wall bracket anchoring and wind resistance
Coaxial RG-6 cable preparation and waterproof F-connectors
LNB skew angle calculation and focus distance
syllabus.labMilestone: Mount dish mast, align to primary satellite, and achieve >85% signal quality.

syllabus.title: Module 2: Multi-LNB Setup & Receiver Programming
syllabus.description: Multi-satellite reception using single dish, DiSEqC switches, and receiver customization.
lessons: Offset LNB focal points on multi-feed brackets
4-port and 8-port DiSEqC switch integration
Digital satellite receiver USB software upgrade
Blind scanning, transponder editing, and channel bouquet organization
syllabus.labMilestone: Setup 3-LNB multi-satellite feed on single dish with auto DiSEqC switching.

courses.audience: Entrepreneurs, technicians, and satellite dish service providers

courses.title: የቪዲዮ ኤዲቲንግ (Video Editing)
courses.description: በPremiere Pro እና DaVinci Resolve ፕሮፌሽናል የቪዲዮ አቆራረጥ፣ የድምፅ ማስተካከያ፣ የቀለም ቅንብር (Color Grading) እና ሞሽን ግራፊክስ። Professional timeline editing, multi-camera cutting, cinematic color grading, sound design, and YouTube/TV exporting.
skills: Adobe Premiere Pro & DaVinci Resolve workflows
Rough cutting, pacing, and visual storytelling
Audio mixing, noise reduction, and sound effects
Text titles, lower thirds, and motion graphics

syllabus.title: Module 1: Professional Editing Workflows & Assembly
syllabus.description: Media management, codecs, proxies, timeline shortcuts, and rhythm-based assembly.
lessons: Project setup, scratch disks, and 4K proxy workflows
Keyboard-driven timeline navigation and ripple editing
J-cuts, L-cuts, and seamless narrative transitions
Multi-camera sequence synchronization by audio waveform
syllabus.labMilestone: Edit full 3-minute dynamic commercial from raw multi-angle footage.

syllabus.title: Module 2: Cinematic Color Grading & Audio Engineering
syllabus.description: Color science, waveform vectorscopes, dialogue cleanup, and final master export.
lessons: Exposure and white balance correction using Lumetri scopes
Cinematic LUT application and skin tone protection
Dialogue leveling, EQ, compression, and background noise removal
Export settings tailored for YouTube, TikTok, and Ethiopian broadcast TV
syllabus.labMilestone: Color grade documentary scene and mix full audio master to standard broadcast LUFS.

courses.audience: Content creators, video producers, and digital media enthusiasts

courses.title: አኒሜሽን አሰራር (Animation Making)
courses.description: የ2ዲ (2D) እና 3ዲ (3D) አኒሜሽን መሰረታዊ መርሆዎች፣ የገጸ-ባህሪያት እንቅስቃሴ፣ የካርቱን ስራዎች እና የቪዥዋል ተፅእኖዎች ስልጠና። 2D and 3D character animation principles, motion design, vector rigging, keyframing, and animated video production.
skills: 12 Principles of Animation (Squash & Stretch, Anticipation, Timing)
Character design, rigging, and bone structures
Keyframing and graph editor speed curves
2D Vector animation in Adobe After Effects

syllabus.title: Module 1: Principles of Movement & 2D Vector Rigging
syllabus.description: Physics of weight, bouncing balls, walk cycles, and character skeletal rigging.
lessons: The 12 fundamental animation principles explained
Creating puppet joints and rigging character limbs
Fluid walk and run cycles with secondary action
Facial expression keyframing and lip-syncing to Amharic dialogue
syllabus.labMilestone: Animate full character walk cycle with organic body weight and head turn.

syllabus.title: Module 2: Motion Graphics & Short Film Production
syllabus.description: Commercial motion design, logo animation, camera transitions, and audio sync.
lessons: Kinetic typography and animated brand reveals
Parallax 2.5D background depth with virtual camera
Particle effects and stylized sound-design integration
Rendering optimized formats for web, games, and broadcast
syllabus.labMilestone: Produce a 30-second animated story complete with character motion, music, and sound effects.

courses.audience: Graphic designers, animators, and digital artists
courses.prerequisites: Basic computer proficiency; drawing ability helpful but not required

courses.title: የኮዲንግና ሶፍትዌር ፕሮግራሚንግ (Coding and Software Programming)
courses.description: ተግባራዊ የኮምፒውተር ፕሮግራሚንግ፣ የዌብሳይት እና የዳታቤዝ አሰራር (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python)፣ እና የሶፍትዌር ፕሮጀክቶች ግንባታ። Hands-on programming fundamentals, web development, algorithm logic, and full-stack project building.
skills: HTML5, modern CSS, and responsive UI layouts
Backend REST APIs and SQL databases
Git version control and GitHub portfolio deployment

syllabus.title: Module 1: Core Programming Logic & Modern Web Foundations
syllabus.description: Variables, loops, data structures, algorithms, and responsive web styling.
lessons: Computational thinking, conditional logic, and functions
HTML semantics and modern responsive layout (Flexbox & Grid)
JavaScript DOM manipulation and event-driven interactivity
Git version control, repositories, and collaborative branching
syllabus.labMilestone: Build an interactive responsive portfolio website deployed live on the internet.

syllabus.title: Module 2: Backend APIs, Databases & Project Architecture
syllabus.description: Server development, relational databases, user authentication, and API endpoints.
lessons: Node.js / Python backend servers and JSON endpoints
SQL database tables, relationships, and queries
User authentication, session tokens, and security best practices
Full-stack integration linking frontend UI to database storage
syllabus.labMilestone: Develop and deploy a complete web application with functional user database.

courses.audience: Beginners seeking tech careers, students, and aspiring software developers

courses.title: መሰረታዊ የኮምፒውተር (Basic Computer)
courses.description: የኮምፒውተር መሰረታዊ እውቀት፣ ማይክሮሶፍት ኦፊስ (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)፣ የኢንተርኔት እና የኢሜይል አጠቃቀም እና ፈጣን ታይፒንግ። Comprehensive computer literacy, professional document formatting, spreadsheet calculations, email etiquette, and cyber hygiene.
skills: Windows OS navigation & file directory organization
Microsoft Word: Professional reports, tables, and letters
Microsoft Excel: Formulas, charts, and budget spreadsheets
Touch typing (Amharic & English) and email correspondence

syllabus.title: Module 1: Operating System Literacy & Word Processing
syllabus.description: Hardware overview, mouse/keyboard mastery, folder management, and Microsoft Word.
lessons: Computer hardware parts and peripheral connections
Windows desktop customization and file organization
Touch typing speed drills (English and Fidel)
Microsoft Word document drafting, formatting, and PDF export
syllabus.labMilestone: Format a 5-page formal business report with cover page, table of contents, and graphics.

syllabus.title: Module 2: Spreadsheets, Presentations & Internet Proficiency
syllabus.description: Excel calculations, presentation design, cloud storage, and secure web browsing.
lessons: Excel rows/columns, math formulas (SUM, AVERAGE, IF), and charts
PowerPoint slide deck design and presentation skills
Google Drive cloud backup and file sharing
Email drafting, professional attachments, and internet safety
syllabus.labMilestone: Create automated inventory spreadsheet and deliver slide presentation.

courses.audience: Students, office workers, job seekers, and anyone beginning their computer journey

courses.title: የኢንዱስትሪ ዕቃዎች ጥገና ስልጠና (Industrial Equipment Maintenance Training)
courses.description: የፋብሪካ እና የኢንዱስትሪ ማሽነሪዎች ጥገና፣ የኤሌክትሪክ ሞተሮች እና ድራይቮች (Drives & Inverters)፣ የሴንሰር ቁጥጥር እና የCOC ብቃት ስልጠና። Industrial electrical machines, motor controls, variable frequency drives (VFD), sensor diagnostics, and preventive maintenance aligned with COC standards.
skills: AC/DC industrial motor testing & rewinding basics
Variable Frequency Drives (VFD) programming & inverter tuning
Magnetic contactors, relays, and motor starters (Star-Delta)

syllabus.title: Module 1: Industrial Electrical Machines & Motor Starters
syllabus.description: Three-phase induction motors, insulation megger tests, magnetic contactors, and starter circuits.
lessons: Three-phase motor stator winding and torque principles
Direct-On-Line (DOL) and Star-Delta starter wiring
Thermal overload relay calibration and phase failure protectors
Insulation resistance (Megger) testing against ground breakdown
syllabus.labMilestone: Wire and commission complete automatic Star-Delta motor starter with forward/reverse control.

syllabus.title: Module 2: Inverters, Variable Frequency Drives (VFD) & Sensors
syllabus.description: VFD installation, acceleration/deceleration parameters, sensor wiring, and fault diagnostics.
lessons: Inverter power stages (rectifier, DC link capacitor, IGBT inverter)
VFD parameter programming for multi-speed motor control
Industrial 24V PNP/NPN sensors and limit switches
Troubleshooting overcurrent, overvoltage, and ground fault errors
syllabus.labMilestone: Program industrial VFD to control conveyor belt motor with optical sensor triggers.

courses.audience: Factory technicians, maintenance engineers, and trainees preparing for COC Level certification
courses.duration: 4 Months (Aligned with COC Industrial Electrical Machines & Drives)

trainingGallery.title: የኤሌክትሮኒክስ ሰርኪውት ሶልደሪንግ እና የቦርድ ጥገና ስልጠና (Soldering Workstations & PCB Assembly)

digitalLibraryResources.title: Complete Mobile Phone Hardware Diagnostic Manual
digitalLibraryResources.description: Step-by-step diagnostic workflows for modern iOS and Android smartphones: battery isolation, VDD power rail tracing, short circuit detection, and screen flex bonding.

digitalLibraryResources.title: Laptop Motherboard Power Sequencing & Schematics
digitalLibraryResources.description: Systematic breakdown of Intel & AMD laptop power states (S5, S3, S0), charging IC pinout diagnostics, 3.3V/5V always-on rails, and embedded controller (EC) communications.

digitalLibraryResources.title: SMD Component Identification & Marking Code Handbook
digitalLibraryResources.description: Quick-lookup guide for surface-mount resistors, ceramic capacitors, diodes, MOSFET markings, and sot-23 packages with diode mode drop values.

digitalLibraryResources.title: Digital Multimeter & Oscilloscope Diagnostic Cheat Sheet
digitalLibraryResources.description: Essential reference charts for signal frequency measurements, ripple voltage probing, capacitor ESR testing, and diode mode readings on micro-components.

digitalLibraryResources.title: Electronics Circuit Board Multi-Layer Analysis
digitalLibraryResources.description: Learn how to read complex schematics, identify buried ground planes, trace high-frequency clock signals, and repair broken trace vias using jumper wire.

digitalLibraryResources.title: LED & Smart TV Display Panel Repair Procedures
digitalLibraryResources.description: Systematic troubleshooting for constant-current backlight drivers, T-CON timing controller clock signals (CKV/STV), and high-voltage SMPS supplies.

digitalLibraryResources.title: Recorded Mobile Micro-Soldering Fundamentals
digitalLibraryResources.description: Video lesson series covering microscope setup, solder paste alloys, tip temperature management, 01005 component alignment, and thermal profiles.

studentProjects.title: iPhone 13 Short Circuit on Main Power Rail
studentProjects.fault: Device completely dead, pulling 2.8A on DC bench power supply immediately upon connection.
studentProjects.diagnosticProcess: Isolated VDD_MAIN using thermal imaging camera; discovered glowing decoupling capacitor C3204 near the power management IC.
studentProjects.solution: Safely desoldered defective capacitor using micro hot tweezers under 45x magnification; replaced with matched capacitance SMD component and verified impedance with diode mode test.
studentProjects.outcome: Device booted into iOS with 100% data intact. Battery charging and fast-boot validated.

studentProjects.title: Dell Latitude 5420 No-POST Liquid Ingress Recovery
studentProjects.fault: Laptop refused to power on following liquid spill; charging LED blinking amber-white code.
studentProjects.diagnosticProcess: Disassembled motherboard; detected mineral corrosion bridges on 3.3V/5V always-on buck converter controller (RT6575).
studentProjects.solution: Ultrasonic PCB bath in 99.9% isopropyl alcohol; re-tinned oxidized solder pads, replaced two corroded pull-up resistors, and cleared CMOS NVRAM.
studentProjects.outcome: Motherboard completed power-on self-test; boot sequence into Windows verified stable under full CPU stress test.

studentProjects.title: Samsung 55" 4K Smart TV Power Board Reconstruction
studentProjects.fault: Intermittent standby clicking relay sound; backlight did not illuminate and power cycling continuously.
studentProjects.diagnosticProcess: Probed power board (SMPS) with digital multimeter; detected fluctuating 13V rail and bulged filtering electrolytic capacitors.
studentProjects.solution: Discharged high-voltage primary capacitor; replaced degraded Low-ESR capacitors and reseated ribbon cables to the T-CON timing controller.
studentProjects.outcome: Constant 13.2V stable rail restored; crisp 4K display image and audio output fully operational.
